name: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea
summary: North of Auberdine, the Silver Dawning and Mist Veil lie beneath the waves. Murlocs ambushed both night elf vessels as they sailed into port, and their surviving crews seek a way to mourn their lost captains.

sections.title: Tragedy off the Coast
sections.body: Murlocs overwhelmed the Silver Dawning and Mist Veil as the ships approached Auberdine. Both vessels sank in the shallows north of the settlement. Their surviving crews reached shore, but the loss of the ships and their captains weighs on the port.

sections.title: Recovering Lost Memories
sections.body: Gorbold Steelhand, a dwarf in Auberdine, seeks to honor the fallen night elf captains. Murlocs now occupy the underwater wrecks, but the captains' lockboxes remain in the flooded holds. Their logs and personal effects could help the surviving sailors mourn their commanders and lay their spirits to rest.

faq.q: Where are the sunken ships located?
faq.answer: Both wrecks lie underwater off Darkshore, north of the Auberdine docks.

faq.q: What happened to the Silver Dawning and the Mist Veil?
faq.answer: Murlocs ambushed both ships as they sailed toward Auberdine. Their crews were overrun, both captains died, and the vessels sank to the ocean floor.

aliases: who gives deep ocean vast sea
faq.answer: Gorbold Steelhand is a dwarf in Auberdine. He looks out for the surviving sailors and asks for the fallen captains' belongings to be recovered.
The lockboxes hold the fallen night elf captains' logs and personal effects, cherished by the sailors who survived the wrecks.

faq.q: Why do the survivors care so much about these effects?
faq.answer: The captains were respected night elf mariners. Their logs and possessions offer their surviving crews closure and may help put their spirits to rest.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the shipwrecks now?
faq.answer: Murlocs have overtaken the wrecks, treating the hulls as trophies and prowling the surrounding waters.

angles.text: As a night elf, the captains' belongings matter as a matter of ancestral honor. They served Auberdine's maritime trade.
As a dwarf, you can recognize Gorbold Steelhand's instinct to honor fallen comrades and support sailors in foreign ports.
As an Alliance member, you can see how the grieving crew reflects the maritime cooperation between dwarfs and night elves along the Kalimdor coast.
